verses.text: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

segments.text: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth,
Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

verses.text: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud their desert.

segments.text: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth:
Render to the proud
their
desert.

verses.text: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?

segments.text: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked,
How long shall the wicked triumph?

verses.text: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.

segments.text: They prate, they speak arrogantly:
All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.

verses.text: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.

segments.text: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah,
And afflict thy heritage.

verses.text: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.

segments.text: They slay the widow and the sojourner,
And murder the fatherless.

verses.text: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.

segments.text: And they say, Jehovah will not see,
Neither will the God of Jacob consider.

verses.text: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?

segments.text: Consider, ye brutish among the people;
And ye fools, when will ye be wise?

verses.text: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?

segments.text: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear?
He that formed the eye, shall he not see?

verses.text: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, Even he that teacheth man knowledge?

segments.text: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct,
Even
he that teacheth man knowledge?

verses.text: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.

segments.text: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man,
That they are vanity.

verses.text: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;

segments.text: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah,
And teachest out of thy law;

verses.text: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

segments.text: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity,
Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.text: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.

segments.text: For Jehovah will not cast off his people,
Neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.text: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

segments.text: For judgment shall return unto righteousness;
And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.text: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

segments.text: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers?
Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.text: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

segments.text: Unless Jehovah had been my help,
My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

verses.text: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.

segments.text: When I said, My foot slippeth;
Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.

verses.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.

segments.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me
Thy comforts delight my soul.

verses.text: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?

segments.text: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee,
Which frameth mischief by statute?

verses.text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.

segments.text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous,
And condemn the innocent blood.

verses.text: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.

segments.text: But Jehovah hath been my high tower,
And my God the rock of my refuge.

verses.text: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.

segments.text: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity,
And will cut them off in their own wickedness;
Jehovah our God will cut them off.
